title: Tree chart
description: Hierarchies drawn as tidy trees, radial trees, mind maps and org charts: organizations, file systems, taxonomies, plans. The tidy tree (Buchheim / Reingold–Tilford) never overlaps and centers every parent over its children; subtrees collapse and expand with an animation, from a click, the keyboard or the API.

overview.title: Overview
overview.text: TreeChart takes nodes and parent → child edges; nodes without a parent are roots (tree.root picks one). Edges that would create a cycle or a second parent are ignored.
overview.tidy: The tidy tree runs in linear time and takes the size of every node into account: labels never overlap, parents are centered over their children and identical subtrees look the same.
overview.layouts: layout="tree" (left to right by default, any direction), "radial" (rings around the root, labels along the radius), "mindmap" (branches balanced on both sides, colored per branch) and "org" (cards with a title and a subtitle, orthogonal connectors, leaf teams stacked in columns).
overview.collapse: Click a node with children, press Enter on it, or call expand / collapse / toggle: its subtree folds into it with an animation and a badge counts the hidden nodes. collapsed on a node starts it folded.

org-chart.title: Org chart
org-chart.description: Cards with the name and the job title, colored by department, connected by orthogonal lines; teams without reports are stacked in columns to keep the chart narrow. The backend team starts collapsed: click a manager to fold or unfold the team.

mind-map.title: Mind map
mind-map.description: A launch plan around its central topic. The branches are balanced between the two sides by their number of ideas, every branch gets a color, and the lines get thinner away from the center.

radial.title: Radial tree
radial.description: The components of a design system around the library name, with the labels along the radius. The radius grows with the number of leaves so the labels never overlap.

file-tree.title: Collapsible file tree
file-tree.description: A project tree from left to right, colored by file type. Deep folders start collapsed; click a folder to open it, or use the buttons, which call expand(), collapse() and fit() on the ref.

decision-tree.title: Decision tree
decision-tree.description: A loan approval policy as an org layout with labeled branches (edgeLabels). Answer the questions with the radio buttons: the reached outcome is passed as selected and highlight="lineage" lights up the path from the root; tree.collapsible is off so clicks do not fold the questions.

taxonomy-search.title: Category search
taxonomy-search.description: The category taxonomy of a store, with the second level collapsed. Type to select every matching category; Enter or a tag calls focusNode() on the ref, which expands the collapsed ancestors before centering the node, and the breadcrumb of the category is shown below.

disk-usage.title: Disk usage
disk-usage.description: A file system where each node value is the size of the folder, so nodeSize as [min, max] scales the circles with the bytes. Sizes are formatted with Intl.NumberFormat units, the radio buttons switch between the tree and radial layouts, and a click reads the share of the parent folder and of the disk.

wbs.title: Work breakdown structure
wbs.description: The plan of a mobile app release: work packages carry story points and a status, and summary items roll the points and the progress up in their subtitles. The detail level calls expand() and collapse() on the ref, and onToggle reports the points of the folded or unfolded item.

bracket.title: Tournament bracket
bracket.description: A knockout bracket from right to left (direction="RL") with box nodes and orthogonal edges: the final is the root and the teams are the leaves, named with Intl.DisplayNames. Next round reveals results simulated with a seeded generator, and the groups color the teams still in, the eliminated ones and the champion.

TreeChartProps.layout: Kind of tree: tidy tree, radial tree, mind map or org chart
TreeChartProps.direction: Direction of layout="tree": LR (default), RL, TB or BT
TreeChartProps.tree: Tree settings: root, gaps, collapsing, compact columns, card size

GraphTreeOptions.root: Id of the root; the nodes without a parent are roots when omitted
GraphTreeOptions.levelGap: Space between two levels, in layout units; depends on the layout and the labels when omitted
GraphTreeOptions.siblingGap: Space between two neighboring nodes, in layout units
GraphTreeOptions.collapsible: Clicking a node with children collapses or expands it
GraphTreeOptions.compact: Org charts: the cards of the leaf children of a node form a column under it instead of a row
GraphTreeOptions.cardSize: Width and height of the org chart cards, in layout units

GraphToggleEvent.collapsed: Its new state: true when collapsed

GraphTreeLayoutOptions.type: Kind of tree: tree, radial, mindmap or org
GraphTreeLayoutOptions.size: Width and height of each node in layout units
GraphTreeLayoutOptions.collapsed: Indices of the collapsed nodes; their descendants are hidden

GraphTreeLayoutResult.parent: Parent index of each node, -1 for the roots
GraphTreeLayoutResult.depth: Depth of each node, 0 for the roots
GraphTreeLayoutResult.visible: 1 when the node is shown (not below a collapsed node)
GraphTreeLayoutResult.side: Mind maps: -1 on the left, 1 on the right; radial trees: angle of the node in radians
GraphTreeLayoutResult.children: Children of each node, in order
GraphTreeLayoutResult.stacked: 1 when the node is a card of a compact column (org charts)

org.title: Org chart with collapsible teams
org.description: Cards grouped by department, the leaf teams stacked under their manager; clicking a manager collapses or expands the team, and the toggle event is reported below.

mind-map.title: Mind map
mind-map.description: A product launch plan: the branches spread on both sides of the central topic, each branch in its own color; the topics follow the page language.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.nodes: Nodes { id, label, group, value… }; property only
props.edges: Edges { source, target, value, label… }; property only
props.groups: Groups { id, name, color }: legend order, names and colors; property only
props.nodeShape: Shape of the nodes without shape (boxes for DAGs, org charts and mind maps, circles otherwise)
props.edgeStyle: Edge shape; depends on the layout when omitted
props.edgeColor: Edge colors: neutral or tinted with the source / target node
props.arrowStyle: Shape of the arrowheads: open (a slim outlined head) or filled (a solid head in the edge color, following the theme and the highlight)
props.highlight: What hovering / selecting a node highlights
props.locale: Language of the built-in texts (summary, announcements, tooltip, buttons); the page language by default
props.selected: Ids of the selected nodes (changing it updates the selection); property only
props.options: Other engine options (GraphChartOptions: force, circular, dag, tree, nodeSize, edgeWidth, arrows, nodeLabels, edgeLabels, animation, legend, tooltip, interaction, renderer, palette, ariaLabel, labels…); property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) node / edge changed; detail: { type, id, node, edge, index, group, color, degree, clientX, clientY }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-item-click: A node or an edge was clicked (or a node activated with Enter); detail: { type, id, node, edge, index, group, color, degree, clientX, clientY }
events.minerva-toggle: A tree node was collapsed or expanded; detail: { id, collapsed }
events.minerva-group-toggle: The legend showed / hid a group; detail: { group, hidden }
events.minerva-layout-end: The layout is done (the force simulation cooled down); detail: { layout }
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.fit: Fits the visible nodes in the view
methods.focusNode: Centers a node (expanding its collapsed ancestors), optionally zooming
methods.setData: Replaces the data until the properties change again
methods.expand: Expands a node (all nodes without an id)
methods.collapse: Collapses a node (all nodes with children without an id)
methods.getPositions: Current positions of the nodes in layout units
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
